title: Rhubarb Crumble
description: A classic British crumble — tart rhubarb roasted with sugar, topped with a caramelised granola crumble. Easy to assemble and deeply comforting.
steps: Chop the rhubarb into 4cm chunks and place in a crumble dish. Sprinkle with half the sugar and roast for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, caramelise the other half of the sugar in a saucepan over low heat until golden brown.
Remove the rhubarb from the oven. Add a few spoonfuls of rhubarb juice to the caramelised sugar, stirring constantly.
Take off the heat and mix in the granola until coated and sticky. Spread over the roasted rhubarb.
Bake for another 20 minutes until the topping is brown. Serve with ice cream.
notes: Serves 6–8. Great with cardamom custard ice cream.
